description: Parses a Unix timestamp (seconds or ms) or a date string and returns ISO UTC, Unix seconds/ms, the time in a requested IANA time zone, and relative time from now. 0.001 USDC per call via x402.

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.

value.description: Unix seconds/ms or a date string; default now

name: timestamp_convert
